title: Understanding Rank
text: The rank of a dataset is determined by the number of linearly independent columns. Consider how many columns in the dataset might be linearly independent.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: To determine if columns are linearly independent, check if any column can be expressed as a combination of others. Look at the dataset and think about the relationships between columns.
